name: Convenience Store
description: You can buy our own basic necessities in every Convenience Store like, local sim card, pocket wifi and you can also charge your phone/power banks.

name: Balay Dako
description: Balay Dako is a Filipino restaurant located on the Tagaytay-Nasugbu Highway. They serve delicious Filipino food with the Antonio's Group's dedication to quality and detail.

name: Hotel Kimberly Tagaytay
description: Escape to Hotel Kimberly Tagaytay, a family-friendly resort with cool mountain weather and a delightful mini-farm. Enjoy complimentary access to pools, a games room, and a daily buffet breakfast.

name: Hanan Hotel Tagaytay
description: Experience a relaxing stay at Hanan Hotel Tagaytay, formerly known as Tagaytay Wingate Manor. This hotel offers a welcoming atmosphere for your Tagaytay getaway.

name: The Lake Hotel Tagaytay
street: General Emilio Aguinaldo Hi-way Maharlika East
description: The Lake Hotel Tagaytay offers a memorable experience in the heart of Tagaytay City. Join them to "Brighten your Holidays" with their special seasonal events, like their Christmas Lighting Display.

name: The Fatted Calf Tagaytay
description: The Fatted Calf PH is an award-winning farm-to-table restaurant in Tagaytay City. Helmed by Chefs Jayjay and Rhea SyCip, it offers a unique dining experience.

name: M&M BULALOHAN
description: M&M Bulalohan is famous for its delicious signature Bulalo. Enjoy a hearty meal while taking in the beautiful scenic view.

name: Farmer's Table Tagaytay
description: Farmer's Table offers fresh farm-to-table cuisine in a beautiful garden setting. This pet-friendly restaurant also features a countryside buffet nearby.

name: People's Park in the Sky
description: People's Park in the Sky offers the highest vantage point in Tagaytay. Explore the historic unfinished mansion and enjoy 360-degree views of Taal Volcano.

name: Tagaytay Picnic Grove
description: Tagaytay Picnic Grove is a top family spot with picnic huts and an eco-trail. Enjoy the zipline and a panoramic view of Taal Volcano.

name: Puzzle Mansion
description: Puzzle Mansion houses a Guinness-recognized collection of jigsaw puzzles. Admire over 1,000 rare 2D and 3D masterpieces at this unique museum.

name: Tagaytay Rotonda (drop off)
description: The most common drop-off is at the Tagaytay Rotonda, the city's unofficial central hub. This area connects you in all directions and is surrounded by local eateries, small markets, and souvenir shops. From here, you're only a short ride or a breezy walk away from some of the city's most visited attractions.

name: Tagaytay - Nasugbu Highway
description: If your bus is headed further west, it might drop you off along the Tagaytay-Nasugbu Highway, home to some of the best views of Taal Lake and the volcano. This stretch is also where you'll find Sky Ranch and several restaurants with postcard-worthy panoramas.

name: Taal Lake Yacht Club
description: They offer boat trips and tours around Taal Volcano, sailing lessons and kayak rentals also they have team building activities that are open to members and non members.

name: Kavanah Co.Lab
description: Its a coworking space in tagaytay

name: Travel M8 Express Co.
description: They are a travel agency that provide a package for your tour

name: Souvenir Shop
description: A bazaar of souvenir shop close in picnic grove

name: Rowena's Pasalubong
description: Rowena's pasalubong known for their freshly baked tarts and buko pie a must try pasalubong around Tagaytay

name: Mahogany Beef Market & Bulalohan
description: A must visit place in Tagaytay, where they offer a "The Authentic Bulalo" and beef for an affordable price

name: Sky Ranch Tagaytay
description: A scenic amusement park featuring the famous Sky Eye Ferris Wheel. Enjoy exciting rides and breathtaking views of Taal Volcano.

name: Cabin in the Alley
description: Escape to Cabin in the Alley, a stunning modern villa with a scenic balcony view. This serene nature retreat is the perfect place to unplug from city life.

name: Hotel Monticello
description: Hotel Monticello Tagaytay offers stylishly furnished rooms and a refreshing vibe in Tagaytay City. Enjoy a memorable stay with dining at their on-site Cafe Mercedes.

name: Sweet Knot Haven Restaurant
description: Sweet Knot Haven is known for its Asian-Fusion cuisine. Enjoy its Instagrammable aesthetic and romantic theme-dining.

name: Museo Orlina
description: Museo Orlina features the dazzling glass art of Ramon Orlina. Enjoy the sculpture garden and a stunning view of Taal Volcano.

name: Olivarez Plaza Tagaytay
description: Another major stop is Olivarez Plaza, just a few minutes away from Rotonda. It's close to hotels, transport terminals, fast food joints, and even a few spa spots if you want to unwind immediately. It's also a central point for jeepneys and tricycles heading to different parts of the city.

name: Mercury Drug (Ayala Malls Serin)
description: A standard branch of the Philippines' leading drug store, located inside the Ayala Malls Serin complex. Known for prescription fulfillment and comprehensive medical supplies.

name: Mercury Drug (Plaza Carolina)
description: A standalone branch in the commercial center Plaza Carolina, offering medicines, basic medical supplies, and personal care items in a highly accessible area.

name: Tagaytay Medical Center Pharmacy
description: The official 24-hour in-house pharmacy of the Tagaytay Medical Center, providing round-the-clock access to emergency and prescription medication.

name: Extra Care Pharmacy
description: A reliable, independently owned local pharmacy offering medicine and healthcare essentials. This store serves the local residential community and is highly rated for service.

name: Adriano's Events Place
description: A secluded and peaceful venue featuring both an events hall and a scenic Prayer Garden. It is popular for weddings, solemn baptisms, and large spiritual gatherings.

name: Trabiesa Tagaytay
description: A combined cafe, restaurant, and event space known for its beautiful aesthetics and cozy ambiance. It hosts smaller gatherings, workshops, and serves as a unique venue for photo shoots.

name: Puzzle Mansion (Resort)
street: Brgy I. Cuadra Road / Cuadra Street
description: An offbeat museum and resort that holds the Guinness World Record for the largest collection of jigsaw puzzles. Features a wide variety of puzzles, accommodation, an infinity pool, and a café.

name: Museo Orlina (Art Museum)
description: A modern indoor-outdoor museum dedicated to the unique and exquisite glass sculptures created by renowned artist Ramon Orlina. It often hosts exhibits and cultural events.

name: Alami's Ebike Shop
description: Specializes in the rental and sale of electric bikes and scooters. This service is popular for environmentally conscious tourists who want to cruise the Tagaytay ridge with ease.

name: ATV Adventure
description: An established adventure provider offering ATV and 4x4 guided tours through the rougher, scenic trails around the Tagaytay ridge and mountains. Requires booking in advance.

name: PapaDel Bike Shop
description: A highly-rated local bicycle shop that services and sells bikes and accessories. They serve the growing cycling community and are a go-to for bike maintenance and gear supply.

name: Blisse Travel & Tours
description: They provide International and Domestic flights, Private land tour packages, Travel insurance, International and Local hotel Accommodation and Bills Payment

name: Bahay Pastulan Store by Good Shepherd Sisters
description: The best ube jam and buko pie in Tagaytay

name: IGAN HOUSE OF NATIVE PRODUCTS
description: Famous for their native products and wood carvings and also very affordable selling products

name: Southstar Drug (Robinsons Place)
description: A major national pharmacy chain located within Robinsons Place Tagaytay, serving customers with a wide range of branded and generic medicines and wellness products.

name: Hillbarn Tagaytay Events Place
description: A rustic, barn-style venue perfect for private events, weddings, and parties. It offers an indoor space and spacious outdoor grounds with a beautiful, natural Tagaytay ambiance.

name: ANAIA'S Motorcycle Rental
description: A popular rental service for tourists looking to explore Tagaytay and surrounding provinces independently. They rent out scooters and motorcycles, which are essential for navigating the hilly terrain.

name: Alfonso Adventure Park
description: An adventure park near Tagaytay known for various outdoor activities, most notably ATV rides and off-road driving courses, providing the necessary gear and safety training for the experience.
